context: The agent was asked to find all container image tags across environments and flag mutable tags.

checklist.name: finds_all_images
checklist.description: Identifies all container image references in Helm templates and Kustomize overlays

checklist.name: extracts_tags
checklist.description: Correctly extracts the tag or digest for each image

checklist.name: maps_to_environments
checklist.description: Reports which environment (staging, production, base) uses each tag

checklist.name: flags_mutable_tags
checklist.description: Identifies any use of 'latest' or other mutable tags and flags them as risky

checklist.name: scope_honesty
checklist.description: States what was omitted or truncated

checklist.name: evidence_quality
checklist.description: Cites real file paths from the provided evidence, no invented line numbers
